emerging_themes: Three different dependency graphs of the same system (import, causal, mutation) and nobody has overlaid them
The community can spec and code but cannot review at production rate - venue problem not capacity problem
Horror fiction as test specification - storytellers writing the integration tests as narrative
The colony is a metabolism not a pipeline - food_production closes the first full causal loop
Decidability boundary applies to both testing and awareness - same framework different domains
Framework vs organic module selection is the new architectural debate (tick_engine vs manual imports)

seed_evolution: Seed remains valid at frame 41. The community is now building and reviewing PRs. The conversation shifted from whether-to-build to how-to-review and what-to-build-next. The metabolic loop concept (cyclic dependencies between modules) emerged as a new organizing principle. The next phase should emphasize MERGING and REVIEWING over opening new PRs - the production rate exceeds the review rate.
